info.title: Afribox API
info.description: Afribox backend API (SmartParcel). All endpoints accept JSON over POST (unless noted). Authentication is via an `apikey` in the request body: an Application API key, a Business public key, a Business secret key, or (for `/admin/`) a dedicated admin key. Customer read endpoints also accept a `sessiontoken` returned by `/customer/login/`. The HTTP status is 200 (JSON responses are served as `application/json`); the outcome is reported in the body via `statuscode` (`00` = success) and `statusmessage`. A valid request with no results returns `00` with an empty array. Dates are served as `M/d/yyyy h:mm:ss AM/PM` with no timezone (the server is UTC+1); boolean fields are the strings `"True"`/`"False"`.

tags.core: Public reference data: states, cities, boxes, sizes, fees, couriers, delivery areas.
tags.customer: End-user accounts: signup/login/OTP, profile, saved cards, parcels, support.
tags.business: Business/partner accounts: dashboard, boxes, parcels, wallet, transaction history.
tags.kiosk: Locker/device operations: setup, ping, parcel drop/collect, appless reserve/verify, snapshots.
tags.pay: Payments: parcel payment search/success, and the Paystack initialize/verify/status/return/webhook endpoints.
tags.admin: Administrative operations: businesses list and wallet transactions.

POST /pay/initialize/.description: Creates a Paystack transaction. Authentication accepts **either** a Business secret key (B2B) **or** an Application API key plus an optional `customerid` (B2C). `amount` is in major units — XOF francs; the gateway's `×100` is applied internally. Use `metadata.parcelreference` to mark a parcel paid, or `metadata.fulfil="wallet"` to credit a business wallet. The response includes `authorizationurl` (hosted checkout) and `accesscode` (for the Paystack popup).

POST /pay/verify/.description: Verifies a payment by `reference`, records it, and fulfils (parcel paid / wallet credit) idempotently. A previously-recorded success is never downgraded; replaying a reference is safe (fulfilment happens once). On a non-success status it returns `statuscode` 99 "Payment not successful" with `transactionstatus` = Paystack's status. Returns the parcel `collectcode` for parcel payments. `amount`/`fees` are in XOF francs (major unit); `paidat` is ISO 8601 UTC.

POST /pay/status/.description: Returns the recorded status for a reference, self-confirming with Paystack if still pending. Intended for polling by the locker app and WhatsApp bot. `statuscode` is 00 for a known reference — the outcome is `transactionstatus`; terminal values are `success`, `failed`, `abandoned`, `reversed` (stop polling), non-terminal are `ongoing`, `pending`, `processing`, `queued`, `initialized`. No server-enforced interval: poll every ~5 s with backoff and stop on a terminal value. `paidat` is ISO 8601 UTC.

POST /business/pendingdropoffs/.description: Parcels the business has created and that the sender has not yet dropped into a locker (status 1). Requires the **business public key**; `dropcode`/`collectcode` are masked as `"****"`.

POST /business/retrievedparcels/.description: The business's parcels retrieved from a locker. Requires the **business public key**; `dropcode`/`collectcode` are masked as `"****"`.

POST /business/cancelledparcels/.description: The business's cancelled parcels. Requires the **business public key**; `dropcode`/`collectcode` are masked as `"****"`.

POST /customer/parcels/newrequests/.summary: List the customer's new parcel requests

POST /parcel/snapshots/.description: List a parcel's proof-of-delivery snapshots (application key). Each item carries a **signed, expiring** `snapshoturl` for `/parcel/snapshot/image/`.

POST /business/parcels/create/.description: Creates a parcel on behalf of the business and reserves a locker. The request type is always **6** (Ramassage sur place / appless reservation) — it is not a request field. Debits the reservation fee from the wallet (prepaid) and sets the drop-off deadline (`expiresat`, default 72 h). Requires the **Business secret key**. Supports an optional `Idempotency-Key` header: an identical replay returns the first response and does not create a second parcel. For a prepaid business with insufficient balance it returns `statuscode` 99, `errorcode` `INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE` and message `"Insufficient balance. Required: <fee>, Available: <balance>"`. If never dropped off, the reservation expires (status 8), the locker is released and the fee is forfeited (no refund).

POST /customer/parcels/new/.description: Creates a customer parcel and reserves a locker, setting the drop-off deadline (`expiresat`, default 72 h). `requesttypeid` must be `1` (Send parcel — also needs `recipientaddress` and `deliveryareaid`), `2` (Self-storage) or `3` (Customer-to-customer — needs recipient name/phone/email). Other types are refused. If the parcel is never dropped off, the reservation expires (status 8) and the locker is released.

POST /customer/parcels/cancel/.description: Cancels the customer's own parcel (status 1, awaiting drop-off) and releases its locker. The parcel must carry the caller's `customerid` (or a valid `sessiontoken`).

POST /business/parcels/cancel/.description: Cancels a business parcel awaiting drop-off, releases its locker and refunds the reservation fee to the wallet. Requires the **Business secret key**. The response carries `refundedamount`.

POST /business/parcels/search/.summary: Find a business parcel by reference
POST /business/parcels/search/.description: Find one of the business's parcels by `parcelreferencenumber`.

POST /customer/login/.description: Authenticates a customer and returns the profile, the dashboard counters and a dated, revocable `sessiontoken`. Customer read endpoints accept `sessiontoken` in place of `customerid`.

POST /pay/success/.description: Marks a parcel paid only when a successful payment bound to that parcel is found. The parcel and its `collectcode` are returned **only** when the payment is confirmed.

POST /core/boxes/info/.description: One box with its counters, its physical lockers (`lockers[]`) and its service state (`boxonline`, `datelastping`).

POST /core/boxes/list/.summary: List the boxes of the network
POST /core/boxes/list/.description: Every active box in the calling key's network.

POST /core/boxes/available/list/.summary: List boxes with a free locker
POST /core/boxes/available/list/.description: Active boxes in the network that have at least one free compartment (`lockersavailable` is `True`, i.e. `lockersfree` > 0). Availability is a free compartment, not the box's service state.

POST /business/boxes/all/.summary: List all boxes of the business
POST /business/boxes/all/.description: Every box assigned to the business, whatever its service state and whether or not it has a free compartment.

POST /business/boxes/assigned/.summary: List the boxes assigned to the business
POST /business/boxes/assigned/.description: The boxes assigned to the business that are in service.

POST /business/availableboxes/all/.summary: List the business's boxes with a free locker
POST /business/availableboxes/all/.description: The boxes assigned to the business that are in service and have at least one free compartment.

POST /business/pendingpickups/.description: Parcels already dropped into a locker and not yet collected (status 2). Requires the **business public key**; `dropcode`/`collectcode` are masked as `"****"`.

POST /business/parcels/retrieve/.description: Business action to retrieve a parcel that is in a locker (status 2). Requires the secret key.

POST /customer/parcels/info/.description: Returns a single parcel of the customer, by `parceldetailid`, without its timeline.

POST /customer/parcels/info/all/.summary: Get one customer parcel with its timeline
POST /customer/parcels/info/all/.description: Despite the `all` in the path, this takes a single `parceldetailid` and returns that one parcel **plus its `timelines`**.

POST /customer/parcels/reports/.summary: Report the customer's parcels in a date range
POST /customer/parcels/reports/.description: The customer's parcels created within a date range. `datefrom`/`dateto` accept `YYYY-MM-DD` or `MM/DD/YYYY` (month first); see *Dates and time zones*.

POST /kiosk/setup/.summary: Set up a box from its code
POST /kiosk/setup/.description: Establishes a machine's identity from `boxcode` and returns the full box record. A write; safe to call again.

POST /kiosk/ping/.description: Records the box's last-seen time (returned as `datelastping` on the box) and returns only the envelope.

POST /pay/search/.description: Looks a parcel up by `parcelreferencenumber` for the payment flow. `/core/parcels/search/` returns any parcel; this one is the payment-scoped search.

POST /core/parcelstatuses/list/.description: The parcel-status vocabulary (1 New request … 8 Reservation expired).

POST /customer/parcels/all/.description: All of the customer's parcels, newest first. Requires a valid **`sessiontoken`** (from `/customer/login/`); a bare `customerid` is not accepted.

POST /customer/parcels/delivered/.description: The customer's parcels collected by the recipient (status 4).

POST /customer/parcels/enroutetorecipien.summary: List parcels enroute to the recipient
POST /customer/parcels/enroutetorecipien.description: The customer's parcels travelling to the recipient (status 3).

POST /customer/parcels/inlocker/.description: The customer's parcels held in a locker and not yet collected (status 2 or 7).

POST /core/boxes/available/bycity/.description: Boxes that currently have at least one free locker, in one city.

POST /core/boxes/available/bystate/.description: Boxes that currently have at least one free locker, in one state.

POST /business/boxes/city/.summary: List the business's boxes by city
POST /business/boxes/city/.description: The boxes assigned to the business in one city, whatever their service state.

POST /business/boxes/state/.summary: List the business's boxes by state
POST /business/boxes/state/.description: The boxes assigned to the business in one state, whatever their service state.

POST /business/availableboxes/city/.summary: List the business's available boxes by city
POST /business/availableboxes/city/.description: The boxes assigned to the business that are in service and have a free compartment, in one city.

POST /business/availableboxes/state/.summary: List the business's available boxes by state
POST /business/availableboxes/state/.description: The boxes assigned to the business that are in service and have a free compartment, in one state.

POST /business/cities/all/.summary: List the cities of the business network
POST /business/cities/all/.description: The cities covered by the business's network.

POST /business/states/.summary: List the states of the business network
POST /business/states/.description: The states covered by the business's network.

POST /core/billingtypes/list/.description: Billing types used by businesses (for example Prepaid, Postpaid).

POST /core/boxes/availability/.description: Free lockers by size for a box (counts only, no locker numbers).

POST /core/couriers/list/.description: Courier companies known to the network.

POST /core/deliveryareas/list/.description: Delivery areas, optionally filtered by state.

POST /core/fees/appless/.description: Walk-in (appless) reservation fee per size — the schedule `/business/parcels/create/` debits. Current schedule (effective 23 September 2026): Petit 500, Moyen 750, Grand 1250, XGrand 2000. Supersedes the historical 250/600/1000 "Parcel reservation fee" schedule.

POST /core/fees/compute/.description: Compute the fee for a request type and size. **Request type 4** (Application de casier) and **6** (business 'Ramassage sur place') return the appless reservation fee that `/business/parcels/create/` will debit.

POST /core/fees/selfstorage/.description: Self-storage fee per size, per six hours and per hour.

POST /core/parcels/search/.description: Find any parcel in the network by `parcelreferencenumber`. Runs under the **application key** (a client key), so recipient/sender contact details are **masked** (`"****"`); it returns tracking fields only (status, size, box, city/state, amounts, dates).

POST /core/requesttypes/list/.description: The parcel-request-type vocabulary. **Customer** parcel creation may use `1` (Send parcel), `2` (Self-storage) and `3` (Customer-to-customer); **business** creation is fixed to `6` (Ramassage sur place); `7`, `8`, `9` are business/dispatch; `4` is the kiosk appless flow. Labels are served trimmed.

POST /core/sizes/fees/.description: Fees by size for a box and request type (**types 4 and 6** return the appless reservation fees).

POST /core/sizes/list/.description: The size vocabulary (Petit, Moyen, Grand, XGrand).

POST /core/walletfundmodes/list/.description: Wallet funding modes (for example Online/Card, Paystack).

POST /customer/cards/add/.description: Start adding a saved card; returns the Paystack authorization URL to complete in the browser.

POST /customer/cards/delete/.description: Delete one of the customer's saved cards.

POST /customer/cards/info/.description: One of the customer's saved cards.

POST /customer/cards/setdefault/.description: Mark one of the customer's cards as the default.

POST /customer/changepassword/.description: Change the customer's password; requires the current `oldpassword`.

POST /customer/dashboard/.description: The customer's dashboard counters (new requests, in locker, enroute, delivered).

POST /customer/forgotpassword/.description: Start a password reset: emails a **6-digit code** to the registered address (valid **10 minutes**, **max 5 attempts**). Always returns `00` — it never reveals whether the email is registered.

POST /customer/otp/resend/.description: Resend the signup verification code to the **registered** contact (no account-existence disclosure).

POST /customer/otp/verify/.description: Verify the **signup** code and activate the account. It returns no token — sign in with `/customer/login/` to get a `sessiontoken`. (Password resets use `/customer/forgotpassword/` → `/customer/resetpassword/`.)

POST /customer/parcels/hold/.description: Reserves a locker for a short pay-first window (**15 minutes**) while the payer completes Paystack; the locker is released automatically when the hold expires (hourly/2-minute job, plus opportunistic cleanup).

POST /customer/parcels/hold/release/.description: Release a checkout hold and free its locker.

POST /customer/parcels/timeline/.description: The status timeline of one of the customer's parcels.

POST /customer/resetpassword/.description: Complete the reset with `{email, otp, newpassword}`: verifies the emailed code and sets the new password in one step. Invalid/expired code → `09 INVALID_RESET_CODE`. To change a password you already know while signed in, use `/customer/changepassword/`.

POST /customer/signup/.description: Register a customer; sends a one-time code. The response does **not** contain the code, and does not reveal whether the number already exists.

POST /customer/support/.description: Submit a support request for the customer.

POST /business/boxes/info/.description: One box assigned to the business (business key). For any box in the network, use `/core/boxes/info/` with the application key.

POST /business/cities/state/.description: The cities of one state, for the business.

POST /business/dashboard/.description: The business dashboard counters (boxes, lockers, parcels, pending, cancelled, totals).

POST /business/draft/deliveryareas/.description: **Deprecated** — use `/core/deliveryareas/list/`. Reference data for a parcel-creation selector.

POST /business/draft/parceltypes/.description: **Deprecated** — use `/core/requesttypes/list/`. Reference data for a parcel-creation selector. Business parcel creation is fixed to request type 6 (Ramassage sur place); this list is informational only.

POST /business/parcels/info/all/.description: One business parcel **plus its `timelines`**, by `parceldetailid`. Requires the **business public key**; `dropcode`/`collectcode` are masked as `"****"`.

POST /business/parcels/info/.description: One business parcel, by `parceldetailid`. Requires the **business public key**; the opening codes `dropcode`/`collectcode` are served as `"****"` (real codes are returned only under the secret key, e.g. the create response).

POST /business/parcels/reports/.description: The business's parcels within a date range. `datefrom`/`dateto` accept `YYYY-MM-DD` or `MM/DD/YYYY` (month first); see *Dates and time zones*.

POST /business/parcels/timeline/.description: The status timeline of one business parcel.

POST /business/pickedupparcels/.description: The business's parcels already collected by the business. Requires the **business public key**; `dropcode`/`collectcode` are masked as `"****"`.

POST /business/sizes/.description: The size vocabulary available to the business.

POST /business/transactionhistory/.description: The business wallet ledger (credit/debit lines with narration, parcel reference and Paystack reference).

POST /business/wallettransaction/new/.summary: Create a wallet transaction for the business
POST /business/wallettransaction/new/.description: Insert a wallet movement for the business. Requires the **secret key**. `wallettransactiontypeid` 2 = Debit only — **Credit is admin-only** (`99` otherwise). `walletfundmodeid` 1/2/3; manual adjustments use 2 (Back Office). `createdby` is optional (numeric user id; defaults to the business's primary user).

POST /kiosk/parcel/appless/reserve/.description: Reserve a walk-in locker against a paid reference. The backend verifies the payment and claims it (single use).

POST /kiosk/parcel/appless/verify/.description: Check availability and fee for **one** size (by `sizename`) for a walk-in user.

POST /kiosk/parcel/collect/.description: Open a locker to collect a parcel; `unlockcode` is the parcel's `collectcode`.

POST /kiosk/parcel/drop/.description: Open a locker to drop a parcel; `unlockcode` is the parcel's `dropcode`.

POST /kiosk/parcel/snapshot/.description: Upload a proof-of-delivery snapshot (`snapshotevent` dropoff/pickup, `snapshotsequence` 1/2). `parceldetailid` is **authoritative**: the server resolves the parcel and verifies the other identifiers agree (mismatch → `09 PARCEL_IDENTIFIERS_MISMATCH`, unknown parcel → `07`). Retrying the same `(parceldetailid, snapshotevent, snapshotsequence)` is **idempotent** — it returns the existing snapshot rather than storing a duplicate or re-notifying.

POST /admin/businesses/list/.description: List businesses with their balance and network. Requires the **admin key**; scoped to its network (or all networks for a global key).

POST /admin/businesses/wallettransaction.summary: Create a wallet transaction for a business (admin)
POST /admin/businesses/wallettransaction.description: Insert a wallet movement for a business. Requires the **admin key**; refuses businesses outside its network. `wallettransactiontypeid` 1 = Credit, 2 = Debit; `walletfundmodeid` 1/2/3. `createdby` is optional (numeric user id; defaults to 0).

GET /parcel/snapshot/image/.description: Fetch a snapshot image: a signed link (`?snapshotid=..&expires=..&sig=..`) or a plain authenticated request (`?apikey=..&snapshotid=..`).

POST /core/lockerstatuses/list/.description: The locker-status vocabulary: 1 Vacant, 2 Reserved, 3 Occupied.

lockerstatuses.lockerstatusdescription: Locker is empty. No parcel is in it.

POST /business/users/list/.description: The active staff users (`SYS_Users`) of the business — `userid`, `fullname`, `email`. Use a `userid` as `createdby` on wallet writes. Requires the **business public key**.

POST /business/parcels/snapshots/.description: The proof-of-delivery snapshots for one of the **business's own** parcels. `{apikey}` is the **business public key**; `parceldetailid` selects the parcel. **Ownership-checked** — a parcel of another business returns `07`. Each item carries a signed, expiring `snapshoturl`.

snapshotsequence.description: 1 = taken when the locker is unlocked; 2 = taken after the door is closed.

walletfundmodeid.description: 1 = Online / Card, 2 = Back Office, 3 = Paystack. See /core/walletfundmodes/list/. Manual adjustments use 2 (Back Office); 3 is set automatically by the Paystack wallet top-up.

parcelstatusid.description: 1 New parcel request; 2 Dropped parcel in locker; 3 Enroute to recipient; 4 Recipient collected parcel from locker; 5 Cancelled; 6 Archived; 7 Dispatch collected parcel from locker; 8 Reservation expired (awaiting drop-off past the deadline; locker released, fee forfeited). See /core/parcelstatuses/list/.

parcelstatus.description: Label of `parcelstatusid`; never empty — falls back to the id if a label is missing. See /core/parcelstatuses/list/.

transactionstatus.description: `initialized` = created, not yet confirmed; then Paystack's status. Terminal: `success`, `failed`, `abandoned`, `reversed` — stop polling. Non-terminal: `ongoing`, `pending`, `processing`, `queued` — keep polling. `/pay/status/` returns `statuscode` 00 and the value here; poll every ~5 s with backoff, stop on a terminal value.

lockerstatus.description: Locker state: Vacant = empty; Reserved = empty but held for a parcel; Occupied = holds a parcel. See /core/lockerstatuses/list/.

flowtype.description: Informational payment flow, free-form: `web` (B2B/B2C) or `appless` (kiosk). The API does not validate it.

createdby.description: Numeric SYS_Users.UserID of the staff user performing the action; optional on wallet writes (defaults to the business's primary user, or 0). Discover via /business/users/list/.

errorcode.description: Stable, language-invariant error identifier (empty on success). Derived from `statuscode`: MISSING_FIELD, INVALID_FIELD, NOT_ALLOWED_VALUE, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, BUSINESS_RULE, INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE, RESERVED, AUTHENTICATION_FAILED, INTERNAL_ERROR; specific codes are used where meaningful (e.g. PAYMENT_ALREADY_USED, LOCKER_NOT_AVAILABLE, CREDIT_ADMIN_ONLY).

errorfield.description: Request field implicated in the error, when applicable (empty otherwise).

expiresat.description: Reservation deadline for a parcel awaiting drop-off (server-local; `expiresatiso` is the ISO 8601 form). After it passes, the expiry sweep sets the parcel to status 8, releases the locker and forfeits the fee.

otp.description: One-time code: signup activation or a password-reset code from `/customer/forgotpassword/` (6 digits, 10-minute expiry).

get.description: Hosted callback page. Verifies the payment, fulfils it, then redirects to `metadata.returnurl` when present. Returns an HTML page (not JSON). Query parameters: `reference` (or `trxref`).

200.description: HTML landing page (Payment successful / not completed).

post.description: Server-to-server webhook. Paystack signs the raw body with HMAC-SHA512 using the secret key; the signature is sent in the `x-paystack-signature` header and validated. Handles `charge.success` and `charge.failed`. Returns HTTP 200 on success, 403 on invalid signature. Not called by clients.

get.description: Browser landing page used as the Paystack `callback_url` after adding a card. Reads `reference`/`trxref`, verifies the transaction, and stores the card authorization code. Returns an HTML page with the outcome.

Returns the proof-of-delivery image (`image/jpeg`) for a **signed, expiring** link: `?snapshotid=…&expires=…&sig=…`, where `sig` is HMAC-SHA256 over `snapshotid|expires` (issued by `/parcel/snapshots/` or `/business/parcels/snapshots/`, 30-day expiry). There is **no `apikey` fetch** — an application key cannot enumerate proofs by id. Errors are the JSON envelope: `04` missing parameter, `07` not found, `98` invalid or expired link, `429` rate-limited.

parameters.name: expires
parameters.description: Unix timestamp of expiry, issued by the server

200.description: The image bytes (`image/jpeg`) on success; otherwise the JSON envelope.

PaystackVerifyResponse.description: Verified transaction details, including parcel collectcode when applicable.

fees.description: A **string**: the gateway fee **amount** (XOF), not a fee catalogue. See *Responses & errors*.

type.description: Wallet transaction type: Credit or Debit (complete set). See /core/wallettransactiontypes/list/.

fees.description: An **object** `{servicefee, storagefee, totalfees}` — unlike the other `/core/fees/*` endpoints, whose `fees` is an **array**. See *Responses & errors*.
An **array** of service-fee rows (not an object or a string). See *Responses & errors*.
An **array** of self-storage rows (`storagefeepersixhours`, `storagefeeperhour`). See *Responses & errors*.
An **array** of appless rows (`applessfee`). See *Responses & errors*.
A **string** amount for this size — not a fee catalogue. See *Responses & errors*.

boxes.description: A **string count** of the business boxes (e.g. `"5"`) — on the box-list endpoints `boxes` is an **array** instead. See *Responses & errors*.

parceldetailid.description: **Authoritative.** The server resolves the parcel from this id and verifies `parcelid`, `parcelreferencenumber`, `boxid` (and `boxlockernumber` when supplied) agree with it. Not found → `07`; a mismatch → `09 PARCEL_IDENTIFIERS_MISMATCH`.

parcelid.description: Must match the parcel identified by `parceldetailid`.

parcelreferencenumber.description: Must match the parcel identified by `parceldetailid`.

boxid.description: Must match the box of the parcel identified by `parceldetailid`.

boxlockernumber.description: Optional. When supplied it must match the parcel’s current locker.
